More recently, my son had blood in his urine. We submitted a sample at the surgery but did not receive any follow-up. After a week, I called to ask for the results and was told everything was fine, which was why no one had contacted us. This lack of communication was very worrying.

I also took my daughter to have her toenails checked as they had turned black. During the appointment, cancer was mentioned, which was extremely distressing to us. When I asked about a referral to a specialist, I was told it would take over three months as it was not considered a priority. I chose to seek a private opinion the next day, where I was reassured that she was too young for toenail cancer and that the discoloration was simply dye from black socks, which was easily removed.
